arguments.message: The default response‑time metric on the dashboard uses wall‑clock time, so it counts every hour a ticket is open—including nights, weekends and holidays. That’s why a ticket opened on Friday evening can be marked as breached by Saturday morning. If you want the metric to reflect only your defined business hours, you need to set up business hours in **Settings → Reporting → Business hours** and then switch the dashboard view to “business hours” mode, which will exclude time outside those hours from the calculation.
